What changed between two published Players Committee images of [[Jakku: Rey's Encampment]]: left, the image of [[Jakku: Rey's Encampment (Errata)]] (holotable commit e8445f0); right, the image of [[Jakku: Rey's Encampment (Errata)]] (holotable commit 6894629). Both crops are cut from the published images ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/e8445f08fa931119eec2c3f95d5cea095145da26/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual4-Light/large/jakkureysencampment.gif before], [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/6894629d2267392808e0be34eb4aaa7686eced2c/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual4-Light/large/jakkureysencampment.gif after]) with their pixels unchanged; only the white label strip is added.
